. capture confirm variable AIRPOLLUTION2

. if !_rc local pollutants "`pollutants' AIRPOLLUTION2"

.
. * Metabolomic principal components.
. * The full manuscript code uses zMETAB1-zMETAB15 for the 15 metabolomic PCs.

. forvalues i = 1/15
  2.     capture confirm variable zMETAB`i'
  3.     if !_rc local metabolome "`metabolome' zMETAB`i'"
  4.     else
  5.         capture confirm variable METAB`i'
  6.         if !_rc
  7.             capture drop zMETAB`i'
  8.             quietly egen zMETAB`i' = std(METAB`i') if sample_final==1
  9.             label variable zMETAB`i' "Standardized metabolomic PC`i'"
 10.             local metabolome "`metabolome' zMETAB`i'"
 11.
 12.
 13.

.
. * Basic labels.

. capture label variable lnPM2point5_2010     "PM2.5, 2010, loge"

. capture label variable lnPM10_2010          "PM10, 2010, loge"

. capture label variable lnPM2point5_10_2010  "PM2.5-10, 2010, loge"

. capture label variable lnPM2point5_abs_2010 "PM2.5 absorbance, 2010, loge"

. capture label variable lnNO2_2010           "NO2, 2010, loge"

. capture label variable lnNOX_2010           "NOx, 2010, loge"

. capture label variable AIRPOLLUTION1        "Air-pollution PC1"

. capture label variable AIRPOLLUTION2        "Air-pollution PC2"

.
. forvalues i = 1/15
  2.     capture label variable zMETAB`i' "Standardized metabolomic PC`i'"
  3.

.
. ********************************************************************************
. * 1. Standardize continuous biomarkers and air pollutants
. ********************************************************************************
.
. foreach v of local biomarkers
  2.     capture confirm variable `v'
  3.     if !_rc
  4.         capture drop z_`v'
  5.         quietly egen z_`v' = std(`v') if sample_final==1
  6.         local vlab : variable label `v'
  7.         if "`vlab'"=="" local vlab "`v'"
  8.         label variable z_`v' "Standardized `vlab'"
  9.
 10.

.
. foreach v of local pollutants
  2.     capture confirm variable `v'
  3.     if !_rc
  4.         capture drop z_`v'
  5.         quietly egen z_`v' = std(`v') if sample_final==1
  6.         local vlab : variable label `v'
  7.         if "`vlab'"=="" local vlab "`v'"
  8.         label variable z_`v' "Standardized `vlab'"

 10.

. ********************************************************************************
. * 2. Helper program for Benjamini-Hochberg q-values
. ********************************************************************************
.
. capture program drop make_bh_q

. program define make_bh_q
  1.     syntax varname, PVAR(name) QVAR(name)
  2.
.     tempvar obsid rank m rawq
  3.
.     capture drop `qvar'
  4.     gen long `obsid' = _n
  5.
.     preserve
  6.         keep `obsid' `varlist' `pvar'
  7.         keep if !missing(`pvar') & !missing(`varlist')
  8.
.         sort `varlist' `pvar' `obsid'
  9.         by `varlist': gen long `rank' = _n
 10.         by `varlist': gen long `m' = _N
 11.         gen double `rawq' = `pvar' * `m' / `rank'
 12.
.         * Step-up BH monotonicity.
.         gsort `varlist' -`rank'
 13.         gen double `qvar' = .
 14.         by `varlist': replace `qvar' = `rawq' if _n == 1
 15.         by `varlist': replace `qvar' = min(`rawq', `qvar'[_n-1]) if _n > 1
 16.         replace `qvar' = min(`qvar', 1)
 17.
.         keep `obsid' `qvar'
 18.         tempfile qtmp
 19.         save "`qtmp'", replace
 20.     restore
 21.
.     merge 1:1 `obsid' using "`qtmp'", nogen
 22.     drop `obsid'
 23. end

.
. ********************************************************************************
. * 3. Helper program to post continuous interaction estimates
. ********************************************************************************
.
. capture program drop post_continuous_interaction

. program define post_continuous_interaction
  1.     syntax, HANDLE(name) ANALYSISTYPE(string) XVAR(name) ZVAR(name) ///
>         TRANSition(integer) MODEL(string) COVARS(string)
  2.
.     local trlabel = cond(`transition'==1, "Healthy->PD", ///
>                     cond(`transition'==2, "Healthy->Dementia", "Healthy->Death"))
  3.
.     local xlab : variable label `xvar'
  4.     if "`xlab'"=="" local xlab "`xvar'"
  5.
.     local zlab : variable label `zvar'
  6.     if "`zlab'"=="" local zlab "`zvar'"
  7.
.     capture noisily streg c.`xvar'##c.`zvar' `covars' ///
>         if sample_final==1 & _trans`transition'==1, distribution(weibull) nohr
  8.
.     if !_rc
  9.         local intterm c.`xvar'#c.`zvar'
 10.
.         scalar bint  = _b[`intterm']
 11.         scalar seint = _se[`intterm']
 12.         scalar zstat = bint/seint
 13.         scalar pint  = 2*normal(-abs(zstat))
 14.         scalar hrint = exp(bint)
 15.         scalar lci   = exp(bint - invnormal(0.975)*seint)
 16.         scalar uci   = exp(bint + invnormal(0.975)*seint)
 17.
.         scalar Nmodel = e(N)
 18.         capture scalar Kmodel = e(k)
 19.         if _rc scalar Kmodel = e(rank)
 20.
.         scalar AICm = -2*e(ll) + 2*Kmodel
 21.         scalar BICm = -2*e(ll) + ln(e(N))*Kmodel
 22.
.         capture scalar Emodel = e(N_fail)
 23.         if _rc
 24.             quietly count if e(sample) & _d==1
 25.             scalar Emodel = r(N)
 26.
 27.
.         post `handle' ///
>             ("`analysistype'") ///
>             ("`xvar'") ("`xlab'") ///
>             ("`zvar'") ("`zlab'") ///
>             (`transition') ("`trlabel'") ("`model'") ///
>             (Nmodel) (Emodel) ///
>             (bint) (seint) (hrint) (lci) (uci) (pint) (AICm) (BICm)
 28.
 29. end

.
